same_parent_same_inventory_observation.inference: Identical parent arithmetic and call inventory crossed the local residual cap across runs. The packed candidate was never executed, so this gate cannot attribute slowness to lifetime packing or reject its runtime. The immutable no-retry gate result remains closed exactly as recorded.

sites.role: one Python scalar branch at each nonfinal full ReLU reset

static_bans_inside_predict: float or int coercion of a flopscope value
bool coercion or Python truth testing of a flopscope value
Python branching whose condition depends on a flopscope scalar
diagnostic conversion or full-array scan inside the metered estimator path
successor_residual_protocol.required_measurement: fresh-process lean public-predict parent/candidate/parent A/B/A in the pinned 0.16.0/0.12.0 environment
required_fields: absolute residual for both parent calls and the candidate
candidate residual minus the mean parent residual
public output hash and finite result
successor_residual_protocol.protocol_validity_gate: both unchanged-parent calls must be strictly below 0.4 seconds; otherwise the run is non-discriminating and cannot reject the candidate
successor_residual_protocol.candidate_gate: candidate must be strictly below 0.4 seconds and below its preregistered incremental-residual cap
successor_residual_protocol.version_policy: 0.16.0/0.12.0 is the forward-compatibility shipping gate; current board behavior is separately established only by actual graded submissions
successor_residual_protocol.history_policy: do not mutate or retry immutable terminal experiments; apply this protocol only to materially new successors
